title: Current Protection against Retaliation and Dismissal for Employees Who File Complaints on Workplace Discrimination
what_it_is: Current Protection against Retaliation and Dismissal for Employees Who File Complaints on Workplace Discrimination

sections.label: Protection for discrimination complainants
sections.summary: Employees who report workplace discrimination can seek advice and assistance from TAFEP, and the Tripartite Committee on Workplace Fairness is examining possible legislation and whistle-blower protection.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jessica Tan Soon Neo
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Manpower what protection against retaliation and dismissal is currently in place for employees who file complaints on workplace discrimination.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: This covers situations in which a person is dismissed because he or she reported workplace discrimination.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The Tripartite Guidelines on Fair Employment Practices (TGFEP) also require employers to treat all employees based on merit at all phases of employment.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Hence, if an employee reported discrimination and is subsequently treated differently by their employer, they can approach TAFEP for advice and assistance.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: As previously announced, the Tripartite Committee on Workplace Fairness is examining the scope of possible legislation.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The Committee will also examine the issue of protection for whistle-blowers.

sections.label: Whistle-blowing discrimination guidance
sections.summary: Employees who feel discriminated against for whistle-blowing should approach MOM or TAFEP for guidance and assistance, and enforcement action will consider employer targeting of whistle-blowers.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: If the employee does feel discriminated against because of whistle-blowing, then the employee should approach MOM or TAFEP for guidance and we can render any assistance that is needed to further investigate the allegations of such issues against whistle-blowing.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: And we will take into consideration when we take any enforcement action against the employer for targeting the employee for whistle-blowing.

sections.label: Committee guidelines from suggestions
sections.summary: The committee will consider all suggestions and points raised and come up with a set of guidelines.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: The committee will take into consideration all these suggestions and points that have been raised.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: We will come up with a set of guidelines.
